slots_added.description: Alert siren single beep — wiki #2, tier-scaled repeat in PlayAlert(int)
Outdoor wind/birds ambient bed — wiki #4, loops on ambientSource

methods_added.name: PlayBuild()
methods_added.wiki_item: #1 — wall finishing plays a construct sound once (throttled)

methods_added.name: PlayAlert(int tier)
methods_added.tier_scaling: tier<=1 => 2 beeps, tier==2 => 3 beeps, tier>=3 => 4 beeps
methods_added.impl: StartCoroutine(AlertBurstCoroutine) — staggered 0.35s gap, pitch offsets [1.0, 1.08, 0.96, 1.04] for siren sweep
methods_added.wiki_item: #2 — raid event plays alert siren; tier-3 repeats more than tier-1
callers: AIDirector.SpawnRaid() / wolf_pack / high-threat events — Lane B

methods_added.name: ambientSource loop (Start())
methods_added.mechanism: New AudioSource added in Awake(), loop=true, vol=0.18, spatialBlend=0; sfxAmbient assigned + Play() called in Start() if not null
methods_added.independence: Completely separate AudioSource from bgmSource — does NOT replace or share music source
methods_added.wiki_item: #4 — continuous ambient layer audible independent of music

qa_wiring_flags.action: Scene-side SerializeField assignment required on AudioBank GameObject — drag build.wav into sfxBuild field in Inspector
qa_wiring_flags.consequence_if_missing: PlayBuild() null-guards gracefully (no crash), but wall-finish sound will be silent

qa_wiring_flags.action: Scene-side SerializeField assignment required — drag alert.wav into sfxAlert field in Inspector
qa_wiring_flags.consequence_if_missing: PlayAlert() null-guards gracefully, raid siren will be silent

qa_wiring_flags.action: Scene-side SerializeField assignment required — drag ambient.wav into sfxAmbient field in Inspector
qa_wiring_flags.consequence_if_missing: ambientSource.Play() skipped in Start(), ambient bed silent; no crash

qa_wiring_flags.note: ambientSource AudioSource is added programmatically in Awake() — no manual GameObject component needed; only the clip slot requires scene assignment

wiki_acceptance_criteria_addressed: #1: A wall finishing plays a construct sound once (throttled) — PlayBuild() 0.25s throttle, called from BlueprintEntity.Complete() [Lane C]
#2: A raid event plays an alert siren; tier-3 repeats more than tier-1 — PlayAlert(int tier) with 2/3/4 beep scaling, 3s burst guard
#4: With nothing happening, a continuous ambient layer is audible (not the music) — ambientSource loop at vol=0.18 on independent AudioSource

throttle_audit.PlayBuild: 0.25s — BlueprintEntity.Complete() fires once per wall but batch-completions could stack; safe
throttle_audit.PlayAlert: 3.0s burst guard — raid events may fire multiple triggers in same frame; guards overlap
throttle_audit.ambientSource: looping, no throttle needed — set-and-forget in Start()
throttle_audit.sfxSource.pitch_reset: AlertBurstCoroutine resets pitch to 1.0 after each burst to avoid bleeding into other SFX
